title: 统一指令层优先级与 explain 输出

originalAcceptance.criterion: 解析器输出每个层的来源、scope、precedence、trust、token 和冲突。
至少覆盖 AGENTS.md + project rules + skill + role 组合。
UI 或 host-api explain 有测试。

boundaries: The resolver is read-only and does not modify instruction files.
Precedence is fixed as turn override > harness > project rules > AGENTS > role > skill.
No full prompt debugger or second rules source was introduced.
All receipts are agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
